title: Temperley–Lieb Jones–Wenzl Projectors, Traces, and Quotients

items.title: The specialized Hecke Markov trace descends to the diagram quotient
proof_obligations: Construct the Hecke-to-TL map under v+1 invertible and s^2=v; compute the six-term parabolic generators; identify the exact Markov parameter z0=-1/(v+1); use uniqueness to show the Ocneanu trace equals the closure trace pullback and kills the full two-sided quotient ideal.

references.title: Joshua Chen, The Temperley-Lieb Categories and Skein Modules
references.locator: §2.3, Theorem 2.3.2 and Proposition 2.3.6, PDF pp. 20–24; §§5.2–5.4, PDF pp. 47–55. The source recursion proof is used as a comparison, while the root fusion proof is reconstructed locally without its 0/0 convention.

references.locator: §§1.2–2.2, printed pp. 2–4: generator sign, Jones trace, first-boundary semisimplicity, negligible ideal quotient; §§3.2–3.3 and 5, printed pp. 5–8 and 13–16: simple quotient labels and ℓ=3,4,5 cases.

items.title: At loop value zero the normalized closure trace is undefined
proof_obligations: Compute q=i, delta=0, [2]=0; explain unnormalized closure remains defined but delta^{-n} and the next JW denominator do not, without inferring nonexistence.
